value: When Cheap Tokens Get Expensive: The Hidden Cost of Agentic Workflows
Are falling token prices reducing cost per task, or are agents and orchestration increasing token usage enough to offset the savings?

Blended list prices fell from $16.83 to $1.55 per 1M tokens, while weighted tokens per task rose from 122,658 to 616,593.
